$comment: Project knowledge only. Anything here that every project would copy verbatim belongs in orch instead.

verify.$comment: How the acceptance hook (hooks/session-idle) is bounded. retryCap caps how many times a failing verification re-prompts the agent before the task lands on needs-review.

scheduler.$comment: Let the daemon auto-dispatch todo tasks itself (wait_human_start: false tasks only). maxConcurrent caps how many task agents run in this project at once. Edit with `orch project scheduler <n>`; only the committed copy on the base branch applies.
